profile.name: FPGA时序发生器模块
profile.description: 一种面向FPGA时序发生模块的硬件控制接口，用于在实验控制或数据采集中配置并启动可编程序列。可设置序列长度、等待时间、时钟分频、重复参数、外部启动与嵌套循环参数，并向板载存储器写入时序数据后执行输出。
profile.description_en: A hardware control interface for an FPGA sequencer generator module, used to configure and run programmable timing sequences in laboratory control or data acquisition setups. It supports sequence length, wait time, clock division, repeat settings, external start, nested loop parameters, and writing sequence data into onboard memory for execution.

registry.name: FPGA Sequencer Generator
registry.description: FPGA Sequencer Generator是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、初始化、启动、复位、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, get clk divide等操作。
